x: None is correct: only VTOL/multirotor UAVs can land vertically or hover – fixed-wing UAVs need runways or launch/recovery systems and forward motion; many UAVs use fuel engines, hybrids or solar power, not only batteries.

Bronchoscopy examines the airways and lungs, not the nervous system. Myelography (spinal cord imaging), electroencephalography (EEG – brain's electrical activity) and echoencephalography (ultrasound of the brain) are nervous-system tests.
source: Rocket Biology (src/science-tech/rocket-biology.txt) p.20 (EEG – electroencephalogram); bronchoscopy, myelography, echoencephalography: general knowledge, not checked

from_notes: Medulla oblongata Heartbeat, breathing, swallowing, vomiting, coughing, sneezing
x: The medulla oblongata controls involuntary actions – heartbeat, blood pressure, breathing, salivation, swallowing and vomiting. The cerebrum handles voluntary action and thought, the cerebellum balance, and the diencephalon (hypothalamus) temperature, hunger and thirst.

from_notes: Medulla oblongata Heartbeat, breathing, swallowing, vomiting, coughing, sneezing
x: Breathing is controlled by the respiratory centre in the medulla oblongata (with the pons). The cerebellum controls balance, the hypothalamus temperature/hunger, the cerebrum voluntary actions.
